text: Astronomy is the study of celestial objects, space, and the universe as a whole. A fundamental concept in this field is the idea of orbit, which describes the path an object follows around another, often larger, celestial body due to gravity. Planets, asteroids, comets, and even stars and galaxies all exhibit orbits in various forms. Understanding these orbits is crucial for predicting celestial events such as planetary alignments, eclipses, and supernovae. Craters on the moon, Mars, and other planets are also shaped by the constant impact of asteroids and comets, showcasing the dynamic and dynamic nature of our cosmic environment.
